items.name: Lisboa Open 2023
items.information:
Se vai competir pela primeira vez, certifique-se de ler todas as informações em *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisboaOpen2023#26410-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisboaOpen2023#26410-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**Espectadores podem assistir gratuitamente!/Spectators may attend for free!**
